editorialSummary.heading: Early-release days, the Suwannee River Fair and spring break
highlights: August 10 and May 28 are both early-release days.
Students are off for the Suwannee River Fair March 15–17; spring break is April 10–18.
Students return from Christmas break January 5, after a January 4 teacher workday.
paragraphs: Dixie District Schools starts the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, and ends it on Friday, May 28. Both are early-release days. Students also leave early on October 16 for DCMHS Homecoming and December 18 at the end of Term 2. The district calendar does not list dismissal times, so families should check with their school about pickup and bus schedules.

Parent-teacher conferences are scheduled for October 29 and February 11. Neither date is marked as a student holiday or early-release day, but students are off the following day for a teacher workday in each case. Thanksgiving break runs November 21–29. Christmas break begins December 19 and continues through January 4, which is a teacher workday. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

Students have no classes March 15–17 for the Suwannee River Fair, a regional event involving 4-H and FFA youth from Dixie, Gilchrist and Levy counties. Classes are scheduled to resume March 18. Term 3 ends March 19, which is not marked as a holiday or early-release day. Good Friday on March 26 is a separate day off. Spring break runs April 10–18, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, April 19.

The calendar lists DCMHS graduation for May 21 but does not provide a ceremony time or a separate last day for seniors. Families should confirm graduation arrangements with the school. The district's last student day is May 28, and final report cards are scheduled for June 7, after classes have ended.

about.processing: Extracted the one-page PDF text and inspected every month, event row, legend and footer. Yellow means the first and last school days have early release; the pink October 16 and December 18 markings add two more shortened dates. First day, last day and term-end meanings share canonical occurrences rather than duplicate events. October 12 and March 19 are term ends without early-release or no-school marks. The official November 21-29 Thanksgiving and April 10-18 spring ranges include both weekends. Christmas break is one continuous December 19-January 4 student closure; January 4 teacher planning is already covered and is not duplicated. The January 5 return is explicit. March 15-17 fair-related closure, March 26 Good Friday and April 10-18 spring break remain separate, with ordinary class dates between them. The February 12-15 planning window is a derived combination of a workday, weekend and holiday, not an officially named break. The first/last student range contains 210 weekdays, less 31 listed no-class weekdays, giving 179 calculated attendance weekdays. No printed annual student total, weather make-up reserve or separate senior endpoint is supplied. Report cards and progress reports are retained; June 7 final report cards do not extend the student year. August 3-7 and June 1-3 staff workdays and the post-year May 31 holiday are excluded. The revision date and the official file title support the June 25 Board-approved revision; the June 30 PDF creation metadata is not a publication or approval date. The stored hash identifies the local evidence copy only; live PDF byte matching could not be completed. The UF/IFAS Extension Suwannee River Fair page, linked in relatedResources, supports only the regional 4-H/FFA background in the editorial summary. It is not a district academic-calendar source and does not establish any school closure dates.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Dixie County for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026. It is an early-release day, so families should confirm dismissal and bus times with their school.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Dixie County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day for students is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is an early-release day and also marks the end of Term 4.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for Dixie District Schools in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The four early-release dates are August 10, October 16 and December 18, 2026, and May 28, 2027. They include the first and last student days, DCMHS Homecoming and the end of Term 2.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal at Dixie County schools?
faqs.answer: The annual district calendar identifies four early-release dates but does not provide dismissal times. Check your child's school or transportation notice for the pickup and bus schedule on each date.

faqs.question: When is DCMHS Homecoming in 2026?
faqs.answer: DCMHS Homecoming is Friday, October 16, 2026. The district calendar marks it as an early-release day. Check with your child's school for dismissal times.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Dixie County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs from Saturday, November 21 through Sunday, November 29, 2026. Students have the full Thanksgiving school week off, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break in Dixie County for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Christmas break runs from Saturday, December 19, 2026, through Monday, January 4, 2027, giving students 17 consecutive days without classes.

faqs.question: When do Dixie County students return after Christmas break?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a teacher workday, not a student attendance day.

faqs.question: When is Dixie County spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs from Saturday, April 10 through Sunday, April 18, 2027. Students have five school weekdays off and are scheduled to return Monday, April 19.

faqs.question: Are Dixie County schools closed for the Suwannee River Fair in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Monday, March 15 through Wednesday, March 17, 2027, for the Suwannee River Fair. They are scheduled back Thursday, March 18. This closure is separate from spring break in April.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a school holiday in Dixie County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a no-school day for students. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29. Good Friday is separate from both the Suwannee River Fair closure and spring break.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are days off for Dixie County students?
faqs.answer: October 30, 2026 and February 12, 2027 are teacher workdays with no classes for students. January 4, 2027 is also a teacher workday, but it falls within Christmas break.

faqs.question: How long is the Presidents' Day weekend for Dixie County students in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students have four consecutive days without classes, February 12–15, 2027. Friday, February 12 is a teacher workday, and Monday, February 15 is Presidents Day. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in Dixie County in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026 is listed as Labor Day with no school for students. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Dixie County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes Wednesday, November 11, 2026 for Veterans Day. The calendar does not extend the holiday beyond that date, so classes are scheduled to resume Thursday, November 12.

faqs.question: Are Dixie County schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027 is a no-school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is October 12, 2026 a school holiday in Dixie County?
faqs.answer: No student holiday or early release is marked for October 12. The date is listed as the end of Term 1. The October teacher workday with no classes for students is Friday, October 30.

faqs.question: Is March 19, 2027 a day off after the Suwannee River Fair?
faqs.answer: March 19 is listed as the end of Term 3, not a student holiday or early-release day. The fair-related closure ends March 17, and students are scheduled to return March 18.

faqs.question: When are Dixie County parent-teacher conferences in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Parent-teacher conferences are scheduled for October 29, 2026, and February 11, 2027. The district identifies October 29 as a conference night. Families should check with their school for appointment times.

faqs.question: Do students have school on parent-teacher conference days?
faqs.answer: Neither October 29, 2026, nor February 11, 2027, is marked as a student holiday or early-release day. Students have no classes the following days, October 30 and February 12, because of teacher workdays.

faqs.question: When do the four grading terms end in Dixie County schools?
faqs.answer: Term 1 ends October 12, 2026; Term 2 ends December 18, 2026; Term 3 ends March 19, 2027; and Term 4 ends May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 are early-release days. The other two term-end dates are not marked for early release.

faqs.question: When are Dixie County progress reports scheduled for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 10 and November 16, 2026, followed by February 10 and April 29, 2027. These are separate from the district's report-card dates.

faqs.question: When do Dixie County report cards go home in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 19, 2026; January 11, March 29, and June 7, 2027. The final report-card date falls after the May 28 last student day. June 7 is not another day of classes.

faqs.question: When is Dixie County Middle-High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 district calendar lists DCMHS graduation for Friday, May 21, 2027. It does not provide the ceremony time or venue. Check with the school for final arrangements.

faqs.question: Does DCMHS have a separate last day for seniors?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not list a separate last day for seniors. Graduation is scheduled for May 21, 2027, while the districtwide last student day is May 28. The school should confirm any senior-specific attendance requirements.

faqs.question: Which schools follow the Dixie District Schools 2026–27 calendar?
faqs.answer: The district calendar covers Old Town Elementary (Pre-K–3) in Old Town, Ruth Rains Upper Elementary (Grades 4–6) in Cross City, and Dixie County Middle-High School (Grades 7–12) in Cross City. Families should check with their individual schools for dismissal times and school-specific events.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the Dixie County 2026–27 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates work out to 179 scheduled attendance weekdays between August 10, 2026 and May 28, 2027. This excludes 31 listed no-school weekdays and includes the four early-release days. The 179-day figure is calculated from the calendar; it is not an annual total printed in the district PDF.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Dixie County 2026–27 school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The Dixie District Schools Calendars page links the 2026–27 district PDF. Its filename identifies a June 25, 2026 board-approved revision. Check the district's website and school announcements for changes made after that revision.

faqs.question: Does Dixie County's 2026–27 calendar list hurricane makeup days?
faqs.answer: The reviewed district calendar does not identify specific hurricane or weather makeup dates. If weather forces a closure, check district announcements for any changes to the school schedule.
